title: Check Codex CLI availability
responsibility: Checks the Codex version, ChatGPT sign-in and available model and image-generation capabilities.

inputs.name: codexState.command
inputs.description: The Codex executable and initial arguments used for a version check with a ten-second timeout.

inputs.name: codexState.server
inputs.description: The app-server executable and arguments used to query the account, first model-list page and provider capabilities.

outputs.name: codexState
outputs.description: A promise for Codex availability, version, model choices and image-generation support. Requires a ChatGPT account; account reading does not request token refresh. Successful discovery reports the server’s model list and image-generation capability. Failure returns unavailable with a reason and no models; the connection is disposed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The ChatGPT sign-in requirement can produce an Error internally, but discovery errors are caught and their message is returned as the unavailable reason.
